----- Original Message ----- 
From: Andrew Thomas 
To: BUGS at jiscmail.ac.uk 
Sent: Wednesday, September 29, 2004 12:53 PM
Subject: [BUGS] OpenBUGS


We would like to announce that OpenBUGS an open source version of BUGS is now available and has its own web page at http://mathstat.helsinki.fi/openbugs/

Eventually the OpenBUGS code base will replace v1.4 of WinBUGS

Enjoy

    Andrew Thomas


------------------------------------------------------------------- This list is for discussion of modelling issues and the BUGS software. For help with crashes and error messages, first mail bugs at mrc-bsu.cam.ac.uk 
To mail the BUGS list, mail to bugs at jiscmail.ac.uk Before mailing, please check the archive at www.jiscmail.ac.uk/lists/bugs.html Please do not mail attachments to the list. 

To leave the BUGS list, send LEAVE BUGS to jiscmail at jiscmail.ac.uk If this fails, mail bugs-request at jiscmail.ac.uk, NOT the whole list 

	[[alternative HTML version deleted]]
